attributes._cssText: .theme-switch { position: relative; }.theme-switch__trigger, .theme-switch__option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text-primary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }.theme-switch__trigger { min-width: 168px; justify-content: flex-start; }.theme-switch__trigger:hover, .theme-switch__option:hover { background: var(--color-surface-hover); }.theme-switch__chevron { margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-text-secondary); transition: transform 0.15s; }.theme-switch__chevron--open { transform: rotate(180deg); }.theme-switch__menu { position: absolute; right: 0px; top: calc(100% + 4px); z-index: 5; min-width: 100%; margin: 0px; padding: 4px; list-style: none; background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-float); }.theme-switch__option { border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 6px; }.theme-switch__option--selected { background: var(--color-surface-hover); }.theme-switch__option svg:last-child { margin-left: auto; }

node.textContent: How this project is configured. Ask the project owner to change a setting.
Credits QA may spend before the project pauses.
Network Performance, Layout Shift, Glitches, User Experience
Probe for injection, access-control and data-exposure bugs. Needs proof you own the app.
Run up to five recording-driver tasks per harness. Harness capacity scales automatically outside the project container limit.

Open your Vercel project → Settings → Deployment Protection → Protection Bypass for Automation. Create a dedicated secret for Loop QA and enter it below. If you rotated the secret, redeploy the preview. QA will retry this preview and reuse the secret for future previews of this project.
Vercel secrets grant access across that Vercel project. Use a dedicated secret you can revoke. App sign-in credentials are configured separately.
Completed and failed runs for this project.
Credit usage for this project — every metered task and the credits it consumed.

. The email lists the overall results with a link to the overview and a short description and link for each bug found, so you can copy individual bug reports — or every bug report — from the UI and hand them to your agent. If QA is still running, the email is sent automatically once it finishes; otherwise it is sent right away.
Email a summary of this project's QA results
